note: Local files are hosted under /models. Remote NASA URLs are source/download candidates and must pass CORS and runtime viewer tests before being treated as integrated.

models.name: Apollo Lunar Module
models.notes: Inspect mesh hierarchy before representing Apollo 11's abandoned descent stage; the ascent stage departed the Moon.

models.name: Opportunity Mars Exploration Rover (MER-B)
models.notes: Keep Opportunity's landing site distinct from its final resting location.

models.name: InSight Lander (original NASA resource)
models.notes: This is the exact page supplied by the team. NASA lists a 21.32 MB glTF download. The page's direct binary URL has not yet been extracted, so do not set it as the viewer URL.

models.name: InSight Cruise Lander — landed configuration, arm deployed
models.notes: NASA describes this as the landed configuration with solar panels and arm deployed, but before deployment of the seismometer and heat probe. It is a model variant, not a fully equipped final surface configuration.

models.name: Ingenuity Mars Helicopter
models.notes: Retired Mars helicopter; keep this exhibit distinct from active rover missions.

models.name: Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover
models.notes: Perseverance is an active mission asset, not abandoned equipment. Keep it as a comparison/reference model only; do not present it as abandoned or as a core exhibit.

runtimeRequirements: Test NASA CDN CORS before using remoteUrl directly in the browser.
Prefer downloading/self-hosting approved models under public/models when project tooling permits.
Use a Draco-capable GLTF loader where the GLB declares KHR_draco_mesh_compression.
Lazy-load one selected exhibit model at a time and provide image fallback.
Keep exhibit data v3 unchanged; write approved changes to a new versioned data file.
Do not mark any model browser-verified until loaded in the actual project viewer.
